title: Capital Letters and Full Stops
introduction: Practise capital letters and full stops with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: Start a sentence and a person's name with a capital letter. End a statement with a full stop; a direct question ends with a question mark.
rules: Always write the pronoun I as a capital letter.
Check the beginning and end of your sentence.

examples.question: Correct: i am happy.
steps: Always write the pronoun I as a capital letter.

examples.question: Correct: ali is here.
steps: Check the beginning and end of your sentence.
